offsetConvention: Byte offsets in uncompressed shipped drama_center/template.js, not Mach-O addresses. Original code was inspected as text and was not executed.

homeContinuation.drama_current_collections: Last 20 actually loaded exact collection IDs, comma joined
homeContinuation.request_count_in_session: Omitted without an actual native host session ID
homeContinuation.cursor: Remains empty when service returns empty; no synthesized cursor

categories.selection: Preserve each selected raw filter object; use each unselected group native All object

newWorksCopy: New releases in the last 7 days; native scene 8 does not add a recent_days parameter
limits: Two catalog pages per route only; observed has_more does not establish an unlimited or exhaustive catalog. No playback scope change.
